svg.title: 2020 Census tract GEOID identifier reconciliation
svg.desc: Of 461 Census tract GEOIDs in the reviewed inventory, 435 exactly matched candidate StateGIS and Coastal SVI layers and 26 were Census-only. This compares identifiers only and does not establish hazard or AFN coverage.
svg.text: 2020 Census inventory compared with candidate StateGIS and Coastal SVI tract GEOIDs
The 26 Census-only GEOIDs had zero population and housing in the reviewed inventory.
Identifier comparison only. This does not establish hazard-specific or AFN coverage, nor zero need.
